tasks.name: dotnet-format
tasks.//: Verifies only the staged .cs files (in their one project's workspace when they share one); a staged .csproj/.props/.targets/.editorconfig runs the full solution check. CI runs the full check on every PR. scripts/format-staged reads the staged list from git, not from ${staged}: see its header.

tasks.name: ring0-tests
tasks.//: --staged builds the whole solution, then runs only the fast test modules the staged change can affect (scripts/ring0-scope), and every module whenever it cannot decide — scripts/**, .husky/**, test/_shared/**, the shared build files, src/MMLib.Alvo.Abstractions, or any file outside a project. scripts/test-ring0 run by hand, ring1/ring2 and CI run every module. scripts/** and this file are in the list because they DECIDE what the local gate checks: a commit touching only test-ring0 used to run no hook task at all, so the one file that defines the gate was the one file outside it.
